adjudication.rationale: Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the code flow is: 1) Update booking with new attendees in database (line ~85-100), 2) Call eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees (line ~157), 3) Send emails (line ~161-165). If updateCalendarAttendees fails, the database already has the new attendees committed, but the calendar wasn't updated. The function would throw an error, but the database state is inconsistent with the calendar state. This is a real transactional consistency bug - there's no rollback mechanism if the calendar update fails after the database commit.
